annotations.title: Mortgage payment risk and fixed-rate premium

description: finwire model on WIBOR fixings and bank offers: finwire_rate_risk_gauge (Ryzyko raty finwire) - chance that the payment of a PLN 400,000, 30-year variable-rate mortgage rises by more than 5% or 10% (or falls by more than 5%) in 3, 6 and 12 months, with the 10th/50th/90th percentile of the payment and backtest accuracy since 2008 (80% interval coverage); finwire_fixed_rate_premium (Premia za stałą stopę finwire) - the typical 5-year fixed rate minus the expected cost of the variable rate over 5 years, in pp, daily and monthly (ECB MIR), with windows of a negative premium. A model estimate, not a certainty and not advice.

history.description: Number of past daily readings in the summary, default 10.
